businessProfile.productSummary: Consumer wellness and self-care products designed to improve physical and mental well-being.

assumptions: Assumed the advertiser sells consumer-facing wellness products like supplements, vitamins, or functional beverages rather than medical services or B2B solutions.
Assumed a mid-tier price point with an average order value of approximately $50 based on typical DTC wellness brands.
Assumed the brand voice is empathetic, clean, and health-focused.

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: Treats her body like a system to optimize and actively seeks evidence-backed wellness and supplement products.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: Scientifically formulated to optimize your body's natural systems and help you feel your best.

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: Highly active individual focused on physical performance, recovery, and functional health products.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: Support your active lifestyle and speed up recovery with clean, effective wellness essentials.

selectedPersonas.whyRelevant: Values clean ingredients, transparency, and organic wellness products that support personal and environmental health.
selectedPersonas.keyMessage: Feel better inside and out with sustainably sourced, clean-ingredient wellness products.

variants.headline: Optimize your daily system with clinically backed wellness.
variants.body: Support your body's natural baseline with scientifically formulated wellness essentials. Our clinical approach prioritizes full ingredient transparency, targeting biological pathways to help you feel better and function at your absolute peak. Pure, evidence-backed self-care.
variants.rationale: This copy appeals to the optimizer's desire for clinical validation and ingredient transparency by highlighting biological pathways and evidence-backed outcomes.

variants.headline: Accelerate your recovery and support active performance.
variants.body: Don't let fatigue slow your progress. Our clean, effective wellness essentials are engineered to support muscle recovery and physical stamina, helping you bounce back faster from high-intensity training. Elevate your daily routine with targeted, professional-grade physical support.
variants.rationale: This copy focuses directly on athletic recovery and physical performance, using active language that resonates with a dedicated fitness lifestyle.

variants.headline: Sustainably sourced wellness that respects your body and the planet.
variants.body: True well-being starts with ethical choices. Our clean-ingredient wellness products are crafted using fully traceable, sustainably sourced botanical ingredients. We prioritize transparent supply chains and earth-friendly packaging, ensuring you feel better inside and out.
variants.rationale: This copy addresses the buyer's demand for ethical standards by emphasizing supply chain traceability and sustainable sourcing without using vague greenwashing terms.

bidStrategy.rationale: Mid-AOV product: pay per click at 1-2% of order value, a sustainable CPC if roughly 1 in 30 clicks converts

budget.rationale: $1500/publisher/month floor for statistically useful volume × 5 publishers × 1 mid-tier multiplier
